left_defects.translation: patient of excuse / patient of excuse

why: Both render the catchword patiens twice across the break; neither has a defect the other lacks of real weight.
Both join ente/entschieden as so we are / decided with no fidelity defect at the break.

right_defects.translation: write to you about the public utility

why: Each has one minor defect in the letter opening after the break; they weigh the same.
Right keeps the finder as the writer and joins aliquid / ad me scribas naturally; left shifts the subject and splits awkwardly.
Both carry os / et instrumentum across correctly; left leaves Pagina untranslated.

right_defects.translation: For just as water is accustomed to flow down from mountains

why: After the break left mistranslates conjectures and drops the hair-pulling; right only drops a phrase before the break.
Left renders the catchword as a duplicated paragraph opening; right correctly drops it.

left_defects.translation: by our Successors to be confirmed by ordinary authority.

why: Left leaves the hyphenated catchword fragment Ca- before the break and drops the observe clause; right joins cleanly.

left_defects.translation: have infused new and singular grace

why: Both carry in lavacro baptismatis / desponsare voluisti across correctly; left small omission before the break is minor.

right_defects.source: propter dulcedinem nominis sui. Oculi eius ... manus eius
right_defects.translation: your name. Your eyes ... your hands

why: Both handle the break, but right turns the third-person verse into second person just after it.
Both render iuste non / dedi as one sentence before the break and continue identically.
Both carry sanguinem suum / non dubitaverunt fundere across correctly.
Break falls between prayers; both render both sides fully.
Both handle Alterum est / est insigne without duplication; left drops that Pinfon heard it in person.
Both join quae supra / mundum identically and faithfully.
Break is at a paragraph boundary; both render it faithfully.
